comments.comment: Nothing is more life-altering, poverty-perpetuating, and emotionally, physically and cognitively-demanding, than a child. When I was 21 I fell pregnant. My bf at the time and I were happy until my fallopian tube ruptured because the pregnancy turned ectopic. My abortion saved my life. 13 years later, I’m now disabled, jobless and on a Disability Pension and I can’t tell you how grateful I am that the pregnancy didn’t happen; I can’t imagine looking after a kid now when I can barely look after myself.
